en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large school complex arranged around an inner courtyard, with multi‑storey rectangular buildings and a fenced yard in the foreground. Hills rise in the background under a partly cloudy sky. Printed Hungarian text appears in the bottom margin describing the scene as the interior view of the Cistercian Order's Nagy Lajos secondary school in Pécs.
